summary: Re-tested the newly-wired real UI (BusinessLoginPage, ImportReviewsPage, ConversationsPage) against the existing FastAPI backend. All 7 pytest backend cases pass (auth, sources upload/list, LLM analyze, testimonial update+persistence, email-draft). Full E2E Playwright flow passes: invalid password error, valid login redirect to /business/import, .txt transcript upload -> POST /api/sources -> POST /api/sources/{id}/analyze -> import-success -> View Growth Signals -> conversations-page renders conv cards -> detail view shows metric tiles + all 7 signal-* category cards populated by GPT-5.5 -> testimonial draft visible -> Edit/Save persists via PUT /api/sources/{id}/testimonial -> Send-for-approval opens composer prefilled with To/Subject/Body + LinkedIn attachment -> composer-send closes composer and shows demo success toast. No bugs found.

issues: Composer is very wide on 1440px viewport – Send button falls off the right edge and requires scroll_into_view; may be awkward on 13" laptop screens. Consider max-w constraint or making the panel scrollable.

action_items: Optional: constrain the approval-email-composer width or make its inner column horizontally scrollable so the Send button stays in view on ~1440px screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py analyze endpoint is not idempotent – repeated Regenerate clicks trigger duplicate LLM calls; frontend disables the button which mitigates. Consider a lightweight lock or in-flight flag.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True as default – benign here (frontend uses Bearer header) but should be tightened for production.
ConversationsPage.jsx is >1100 lines – consider splitting Composer, Signals grid, ConversationDetail into separate components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ source uploaded via pytest and one demo brightpath transcript uploaded via UI. DB now contains ~2 sources for the demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is at /business (not /login). Dashboard layout guards /business/* and redirects to /business if uplaud_business_auth_v1 is missing. Analyze endpoint uses real GPT-5.5 (~10-25s). Email composer send is intentionally a front-end no-op that shows a toast. If you retest, consider clearing the sources collection to keep the conversations list tidy.
